digest.component_or_area: rebar project extension — code-review criterion authoring and calibration
propositions: A project criterion must be authored that enforces strict phase separation in code-review prompts: Pass 1 discovers only, Pass 2 verifies only, Pass 3 decides deterministically, and Pass 4 coaches non-prescriptively.

The criterion implementation must emit grounded evidence findings with no severity, confidence, or suggested_fix fields, use single-turn execution with diff context, and route via criteria_routing.json with advisory posture.

A balanced twelve-case eval corpus (RP-F1..F6 must-fire, RP-N1..N6 must-not-fire) must achieve recall 1.0, false_accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, stability_min ≥2/3, and Cohen kappa ≥0.70 across three calibration runs.

The implementation must remain entirely project-owned, changing only .rebar/ prompt/routing/eval assets, .gitignore, criterion-specific tests, and docs/llm-framework.md, with no changes to kernel or generic integration code.
